title: feat: sharper Bee Census questions; pay only for written answers
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Required single-choice dropdowns started on their first option (e.g. "Very disappointed" 8/12). All required dropdowns are now multi-select, which starts empty; spend and vanish say "Pick one."
- Replaces the generic wishlist with "What did you last try to build that Pollinations couldn't do?" and adds "What would make you pay this month?", each with an example.
- Adds a plan price question ($3–$50+ / wouldn't subscribe) and an example placeholder for "Where exactly?".
- The `bee_census` quest pays only when the written answers total at least 60 characters (issue forms can't enforce length). Short answers can be edited and count on the next check; rewards already stored stay paid.
- Test: a short survey pays nothing, a full one pays 3 Pollen once.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The census asks better questions
gist.blurb: Bee Census now starts with genuinely empty choices and asks what you tried to build. Write a little more about it, and the 3 Pollen reward is ready to claim.
gist.summary: Bee Census now uses empty-starting required choices, asks about unmet projects and willingness to pay, and awards its 3 Pollen quest reward when written answers total at least 60 characters.
gist.impact: Respondents can choose answers without a preselected option, edit short responses to qualify on the next check, and receive the 3 Pollen reward once.
